name: TokenField
summary: Edits a list of plain text tokens inline; Enter turns typed text into a token.

useWhen: Entering tags or keywords as plain text tokens edited in place
avoidWhen: Tokens that need validation, a limit, or a rejection message; use InputTags
Choosing from predefined values with ids; use TagSelect
Mentions or tokens that carry an id or other data, because a token is only a string
Entering a single scalar value; use TextField

obligations: Relate the label and input to inline tokens.
Expose disabled and read-only state and normalized values.

behavior: Controlled and uncontrolled string token arrays are supported.
Backspace removes the adjacent token when focused.
Typed text stays a draft until Enter turns it into a token in place.
Enter trims each typed text run, and blank drafts are ignored.
Comma has no special meaning, and duplicate tokens are kept.
onChange reports only the token array, and fires only when the tokens change.
A named TokenField submits one form entry per token under its name; read them with FormData.getAll.
An empty token array submits no entry, a disabled field submits no tokens, and a read-only field still submits its tokens.
Text that has not been turned into a token is not submitted.
Resetting the form restores an uncontrolled field to the tokens it had when it mounted and clears the draft text.
A later change to defaultValue does not replace the tokens a reset restores.
A controlled field is not changed by a reset, so the application restores it.
accessibility: Relate the label and input to inline tokens.
Expose disabled and read-only state and normalized values.

requirements.reason: Native dynamic colors do not apply to the React web binding.
Native font metrics do not apply to the React web binding.
